notes.title: Update 1.0.1 Available
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing Wild Guns Reloaded!
 
We have just released an updated version that fixes the issue of Kaspersky anti-virus software.
 
We hope everyone enjoys the game and we're always reading the CommunityHub so don't hesitate to leave feedback!
